preconditions.description: The input size n is a positive integer between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i < 2**60 for b_i in b_list)
preconditions.description: Each integer b_i in the input list satisfies 1 ≤ b_i < 2^60.
The input list b_list contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'No' (no valid permutation) or 'Yes' followed by a permutation of b_list.
If 'Yes', the output permutation is a valid rearrangement of the input b_list.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or (stdout.split()[0] == 'Yes' and all(a_i < a_{i+1} for i in range(n-1)))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the sequence a_i = b'_1 ⊕ ... ⊕ b'_i is strictly increasing, where b'_i is the output permutation.
